# Adobe Stock

> Adobe Stock is a digital creative marketplace offering millions of royalty-free stock photos, vectors, illustrations, and videos for licensing, with a companion contributor platform for creators to sell their work.

Adobe Stock serves both consumers seeking high-quality creative assets and contributors looking to monetize their work. The platform integrates with Adobe Creative Cloud and supports multiple languages, making it a global hub for digital content licensing and creative commerce.

## Key Topics

## Core Platform

- [Adobe Stock Homepage](https://www.stock.adobe.com/): Main entry point to Adobe Stock's marketplace of millions of royalty-free creative assets including photos, vectors, illustrations, and videos
- [Contributor Platform](https://contributor.stock.adobe.com/): Platform for creators to upload and sell their photos, footage, illustrations, and vector designs to earn royalties

## Localized Versions

- [Adobe Stock Contributor (Russian)](https://contributor.stock.adobe.com/ru): Russian-language version of the Adobe Stock contributor platform for selling creative work online
